KEY PRODUCT FEATURES

• 100-card ready-to-play Strixhaven (STX) Commander deck (2 foil, 98 nonfoil cards)
• 1 foil etched Display Commander
• 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker and deck box
• 17 Magic cards make their debut
• Reduced-plastic packaging
• Choose your college at the most prestigious university for magical learning in MTG's Multiverse
• Join Silverquill College and manipulate your opponents with the power of words

CONTENTS

Welcome to Strixhaven, the most prestigious university for magical learning in Magic’s Multiverse. Join your fellow students in the college of Silverquill and battle it out with this Black-White Strixhaven Commander deck.

The Silverquill Strixhaven: School of Mages Commander Deck set includes 1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards (2 foil, 98 nonfoil), 1 foil etched Display Commander, 10 double-sided tokens, 1 life tracker, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), and 1 reference card, all in reduced-plastic packaging.
